title: SAPS
description: Server-side Fabric mod for admins to prank players with scary sounds (creeper hiss, TNT, cave ambient) and harmless cosmetic lightning.
body:
# SAPS

**SAPS** is a lightweight, strictly **server-side** Fabric mod designed for server administrators who want to have some harmless fun and prank their players. With simple commands, you can trigger jump-scare sound effects or strike players with beautiful, completely safe lightning.

Since it is **100% Server-Side**, your players do not need to install anything! Just drop it into your server's `mods` folder and start trolling.

---

## Features

* **Phantom Sounds:** Play terrifying audio cues directly to a specific player. The audio source tracks their coordinates perfectly.
* **Cosmetic Lightning:** Strike a player with lightning that flashes and thunders but deals **zero damage** and **never sets blocks on fire**.
* **Smart Tab-Completion:** Fully integrated with Minecraft's command suggestions. You don't need to memorize sound names.
* **Stealthy & Vanilla-Friendly:** Sounds play under the `Hostile` category, making players believe a real monster is creeping right behind them.

---

## Commands

*All commands require operator permissions (**OP level 2** or higher).*

### 🔊 1. Play a Prank Sound
```text
/serverprank sound <player> <sound_type>
```

**Available sounds out of the box:**
* `creeper_hiss` — The classic, heart-stopping hiss of a priming Creeper.
* `tnt_fuse` — The burning fuse of an invisible TNT block.
* `cave_scary` — A spooky cave ambience sound, pitched down for maximum creepiness.
* `enderman_scream` — The terrifying screech of an angered Enderman.
* `wither_spawn` — The global-sounding rumble of a Wither being summoned.
* `ghast_scream` — The sudden high-pitched shriek of a Ghast.
* `anvil_land` — A loud, heavy metallic clang of a dropping anvil.
* `guardian_laser` — The intense charging sound of an Elder Guardian laser beam.

### ⚡ 2. Summon Fake Lightning
```text
/serverprank strike <player>
```
Instantly summons a cosmetic lightning bolt on the player's exact location. Perfect for dramatic entrances, comical punishments, or pure shock value.

---

## Requirements

* **Platform:** Fabric
* **Environment:** Server-only (`DedicatedServerModInitializer`)
* **Client Side:** Not required. Vanilla clients can join without any issues.
* **Permissions:** Level 2 (Vanilla OP / LuckPerms command node support)
